search_results.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6
search_results.description: Dense grid for maximum scannability. Images top, details bottom.

dashboard.description: Asymmetric grid. Hero chart spans 8 cols, alerts span 4 cols.

images.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Use 'Snowflake' for cooling, 'Flame' for heating, 'Truck' for shipping.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'lucide-react' and 'recharts'. Configure Tailwind with the colors and fonts specified above.
2. FONTS: Add 'Outfit' and 'DM Sans' via Google Fonts in index.html or CSS import.
3. LAYOUT: Create a 'Layout' component that enforces the max-width container and consistent padding.
4. COMPONENTS: Build the 'ProductCard' first. It is the core of the experience. Ensure the 'Refurbished' badge is distinct.
5. SEARCH: The search bar should be the hero of the home page. Large, centered, inviting.
6. FILTERS: Use a sidebar on desktop and a Drawer (Shadcn Sheet) on mobile.
7. CHARTS: Use Recharts for the 'Price History' modal. Keep it simple: Line chart, minimal axes.
8. MOCK DATA: Create a robust mock data file for products since we don't have a real backend yet. Include 'condition' (new, used, refurbished) fields.
9. TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (search input, filter checkboxes, product cards).

do_not: Do not use gradients for text.
Do not make the UI cluttered. White space is luxury.
Do not use generic 'Loading...' text. Use skeleton screens.
